presets.name: Bare
presets.summary: No head fitting, no chest panel.
presets.description: Both of those components are optional already. Off, what is left is the chassis itself, and the face is the only thing that varies.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.summary: One warm brown across every face of the cube.
presets.description: The chest panel skips its button variant here. Those buttons are painted red in the artwork rather than taking a color option, and one red dot undoes a monochrome set.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: Steel, with the screen still darker than the shell.
presets.description: The style shades every cube face separately, so a set of greys keeps all its depth. Same exclusion as Sepia for the red buttons.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.summary: One teal shell, one lime screen.
presets.description: Two colors and their shading. Only the eyes, mouth and head fitting change from avatar to avatar, which makes a set read as one production run.

presets.name: Muted
presets.description: The style's shell colors are candy-bright. These are the same idea in tones that hold still, for a list where a dozen bots appear at once. The red button panel is excluded, since one saturated dot is enough to break a quiet set.

presets.name: Electric
presets.description: Only the lit parts go loud. Bright shell and bright glow together cancel each other out, so the chassis stays pale and the screen carries the color.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.summary: Soft ground, the style's own chassis.
presets.description: Six backgrounds instead of the five the style ships, all of them light enough that the dark screen stays the darkest thing in the frame.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.summary: Saturated ground behind a pastel bot.
presets.description: The chassis colors are soft, so a loud background pushes them forward instead of competing with them.

presets.name: Night Shift
presets.description: For dark interfaces. The chassis keeps its light metal so the bot does not disappear into the ground, and the screen glow becomes the brightest thing on the tile.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient behind the bot.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. The seed still decides which of the two ends up on top, so the light comes from either side across a set.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.summary: Head and torso, feet cropped away.
presets.description: The full bot is small at avatar sizes and most of its identity is in the face. This crops to the top two thirds and keeps whatever is mounted on the head.

presets.name: Animated
presets.summary: Turns the style's built-in animation on.
presets.description: The animation is off by default and `animation: true` switches it on. `liftAnimation: true` plays just that one, and `animationSpeed` sets the pace. The motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
